title: Opposing cam flanks and loaded winding drum
question: Drive A CW. Determine the motion of W (vertical) at the shown instant. Use the labeled contact views.

answer.explanation: Drive A CW. One positive angular increment changes the sampled radii by 2 and -2 mm. The two radii must sum to the fixed center distance. A positive, B positive. The taut line follows the left tangent of drum B; CW there is up. B positive, W positive. The requested motion is up (in listed output order).

options.label: A
options.explanation: W must be up. The taut line follows the left tangent of drum B; CW there is up. B positive, W positive..
